## Load data

```{r}
TCR_data    = fread(file.path(data_dir, sprintf("TCR_%s_5.tsv", chain)))
mut_data    = fread(file.path(data_dir, "mutation_freq_geq_5.tsv"))
sample_info = fread(file.path(data_dir, "sample_info_intersection.tsv"))

dim(TCR_data)
dim(mut_data)
dim(sample_info)

head(TCR_data)
head(mut_data)
head(sample_info)

participants = sample_info$participant

TCR_mat = get_TCR_matrix(TCR_data, participants)
mut_mat = get_mut_matrix(mut_data, participants)

dim(TCR_mat)
TCR_mat[1:2,1:3]

dim(mut_mat)
mut_mat[1:2,1:3]

stopifnot(setequal(participants, colnames(TCR_mat)))
stopifnot(setequal(participants, colnames(mut_mat)))

TCR_mat = TCR_mat[,match(participants, colnames(TCR_mat))]
mut_mat = mut_mat[,match(participants, colnames(mut_mat))]

TCR_mat[1:2,1:4]
mut_mat[1:2,1:4]
sample_info[1:4,]
```

## load association results

Results with or without read-depth interaction

```{r}
res0 = fread(file.path(result_dir, 
                      sprintf("TCR_%s_mut_associations.tsv", chain)))
res0$gene = str_extract(res0$mut, "[A-Za-z0-9]+(?=:)")

dim(res0)
res0[1:2,]

table(nchar(res0$mut) < 1000)
summary(res0$pval_LRT)

res1 = fread(file.path(result_dir, 
                      sprintf("TCR_%s_mut_asso_rd_interaction.tsv", chain)))
res1$gene = str_extract(res1$mut, "[A-Za-z0-9]+(?=:)")

dim(res1)
res1[1:2,]

table(nchar(res1$mut) < 1000)
summary(res1$pval_LRT)
```

## Compare p-values
```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
ggplot(res0, aes(x=pval_LRT))+
  geom_histogram(color="darkblue", fill="lightblue", 
                 breaks=seq(0,0.5,by=0.01)) + 
  ggtitle("without read-depth interaction")

ggplot(res1, aes(x=pval_LRT))+
  geom_histogram(color="darkblue", fill="lightblue", 
                 breaks=seq(0,0.5,by=0.01)) + 
  ggtitle("with read-depth interaction")

res = merge(res0, res1, by = c("TCR", "mut", "gene"), all = TRUE, 
            suffixes = c("_without_rd_x", "_with_rd_x"))
dim(res)
res[1:2,]

table(is.na(res$pval_LRT_without_rd_x))
table(is.na(res$pval_LRT_with_rd_x))

summary(res$pval_LRT_with_rd_x[is.na(res$pval_LRT_without_rd_x)])
summary(res$pval_LRT_without_rd_x[is.na(res$pval_LRT_with_rd_x)])

ggplot(data = res, mapping = aes(x = -log10(pval_LRT_without_rd_x), 
                                 y = -log10(pval_LRT_with_rd_x))) +
  geom_pointdensity() + scale_color_viridis() + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth=1.5, color = "red")

rm(res)
```

# Check association results

## Add additional results

The LRT test did not consider directions. Here we only keep those with  AUC > 0.5.
```{r}
TCR_rd  = log10(sample_info$abundance)

num_cores = 12

registerDoParallel(cores=num_cores)

date()
add_res <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(res1), .combine="rbind") %dopar% {

  tcr_i = TCR_mat[rownames(TCR_mat) == res1$TCR[i],]
  mut_i = mut_mat[rownames(mut_mat) == res1$mut[i],]
  
  # r1 = ("TCR_freq", "mut_freq", "overlap", "pval_no_interaction",
  #       "fisher_pval", "auc", "auc_resid")
  r1 = rep(NA, 6)
  
  r1[1] = sum(tcr_i)
  r1[2] = sum(mut_i)
  r1[3] = sum(tcr_i*mut_i)
  
  l0 = glm(tcr_i ~ TCR_rd, family = "binomial")
  l1 = glm(tcr_i ~ TCR_rd + mut_i, family = "binomial")
  a1 = anova(l0, l1, test = "LRT")
  r1[4] = a1$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
  
  r1[5] = fisher.test(tcr_i, mut_i)$p.value
  r1[6] = pROC::auc(response=mut_i, predictor=tcr_i, 
              quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
  
  r1
}
date()

add_res = data.table(add_res)
names(add_res) = c("TCR_freq", "mut_freq", "overlap", "pval_no_interaction", 
                   "fisher_pval", "auc")
dim(add_res)
add_res[1:2,]

res = cbind(res1, add_res)

table(res$auc > 0.5)
res[res$auc <= 0.5,][1:5,]
sort(table(res$mut[res$auc <= 0.5]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]

res = res[auc > 0.5,]

res$sensitivity = res$overlap/res$mut_freq
res$precision   = res$overlap/res$TCR_freq

dim(res)
res[1:5,]

summary(res$precision)
summary(res$sensitivity)
```

## Scatter plots of metrics

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.2}
table(res$overlap)
res$overlap_grp = as.character(res$overlap)
res$overlap_grp[res$overlap > 2] = "3+"
res$transparency = 0.6
res[overlap >= 2, transparency:= 0.8]
table(res$overlap_grp, res$transparency)


ggplot(data = res, mapping = aes(x = -log10(pval_LRT), 
                                 y = -log10(fisher_pval))) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = transparency, color = overlap_grp)) + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype="dashed")

ggplot(data = res, mapping = aes(x = -log10(pval_LRT), 
                                 y = -log10(pval_no_interaction))) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = transparency, color = overlap_grp)) + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype="dashed")

ggplot(data = res, mapping = aes(x = -log10(pval_LRT), y = auc)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = transparency, color = overlap_grp))

ggplot(data = res, mapping = aes(x = sensitivity, y = precision)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = transparency, color = overlap_grp)) + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype="dashed")

```

## Check AUCs
```{r}
table(res$pval_LRT < 0.1, res$overlap > 1)
table(res$pval_LRT < 0.1, res$fisher_pval < 0.1)
table(res$pval_LRT < 0.1, res$pval_no_interaction < 0.1)

res[,transparency := NULL]
summary(res$auc)


ggplot(res, aes(x=auc)) +
  geom_histogram(color="darkblue", fill="lightblue", 
                 breaks=seq(0.5,0.72, by=0.01)) + 
  scale_y_log10()

res2 = res[auc > 0.6,]
t_gene = table(res2$gene)
sort(t_gene, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]

res2[gene == "TP53",]

table(table(res2$mut))
```

## Check whether some mutations are associated with multiple TCRs

```{r}
t_mut = table(res$mut)
summary(as.numeric(t_mut))
quantile(t_mut, probs=0.99)

mut_freq = sort(t_mut, decreasing = TRUE)
mut_freq[mut_freq >= quantile(t_mut, probs=0.99)]

TP53_top = names(mut_freq)[grep("TP53", names(mut_freq))[1]]
TP53_top

res_TP53 = res[mut == TP53_top, c("TCR", "pval_LRT", "TCR_freq", "mut_freq", 
                       "overlap", "auc")]
res_TP53

wTCR = which(rownames(TCR_mat) %in% res_TP53$TCR)
combine_TCR = colSums(TCR_mat[wTCR,])
TP53 = mut_mat[rownames(mut_mat) == TP53_top,]
table(combine_TCR, TP53)

TCR_TP53_1 = as.numeric(combine_TCR > 0)
TCR_TP53_2 = as.numeric(combine_TCR > 1)

pROC::auc(response=TP53, predictor=TCR_TP53_1, 
              quiet=TRUE, direction="<")

pROC::auc(response=TP53, predictor=TCR_TP53_2, 
              quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
```

## Check whether some TCRs are associated with multiple mutations
```{r}
t_tcr = table(res$TCR)
summary(as.numeric(t_tcr))
quantile(t_tcr, probs=0.99)
sort(t_tcr[t_tcr >= quantile(t_tcr, probs=0.99)])

res3 = res[TCR == names(t_tcr)[which.max(t_tcr)],]
dim(res3)

sort(table(res3$gene), decreasing=TRUE)[1:10]
table(res$overlap)
table(res3$overlap)
```
